guidance.scope: An occurrence study links a general lemma entry to an exact verse or phrase. Keep theological interpretations distinct from lexical analysis.
guidance.spans: Use exact source token IDs plus English span selectors tied to a text snapshot. Include the selected text and contextual anchors; validate after revision.
guidance.alternatives: Each alternative needs wording, classification (direct_rendering, explanatory_rendering or interpretive_reading), evidence_ids, contextual_reason and limitation.
guidance.interpretations: Each attributed view needs named source/author/tradition, exact locator, source_checked_on, accurate summary, relation to the Greek evidence and review status.
guidance.colour: Thematic categories describe context, not lexical senses. Studies must remain reachable when colours are disabled.
guidance.publication: Do not auto-publish a draft or a stale study. Confirm the existing storage/renderer before adapting this planning shape.
